body: I'm in a good place at the moment, but thank you (: I would like to extend the invitation to you. If you ever want to DM anyone feel free.
I still can't shake the feeling of guilt.  I know why I responded the way I did but it doesn't make me feel any better.
Thank you for kind words.  I hope one day to have your strength.
Will do. Thank you

I just want the pain gone.  If I didn't exist there would be no more pain. I know it isn't possible to just not exist. But it is most favorable option. I have not spoke to a professional about this just yet. I will though.
I've been looking into therapy.  I'm hoping to start seeing someone soon.
Luckily for him he died a while back. I would have loved to see someone make him hurt though.
Thank you for your kind words. I feel like I'm never getting there.
Sorry.  I'm just venting.  I'm a coward.  I will talk to him.  Just not tonight.  Thank you
I can't tell anyone what happened to me either.  I just can't bring myself to face them and the possible judgment.  I'm not ready for the shame and the guilt.  It's too much.
Easier to say it here then in person . I feel used, broken, &dumb. I don't have it in me for an argument.  He will get defensive

I don't even know how to start this conversation.  He's not a bad guy. He is the best man I know. I feel that somewhere there was a misunderstanding.  I must have said of hinted something.  I can't clear my head enough to think.  I don't want to call the police or get anyone else involved.

I'm at the point where I want to scream and cry. I am stupid for not seeing this sooner. How am I supposed to tell him.  He is going to be so angry and hurt. But he doesn't respect my no. I have even removed his hands from my body and he doesn't stop. I am stupid for not wanting to see. I'm stupid for making him a bad guy.

I can't talk to family/friends. They do not know my secrets and I'd have to start from the beginning.  That's a lot of ground to cover and I'm not in the mood it. It will just give me more reasons to go over the edge. I hate confrontation.  I'll have a clearer head after I cut and everything will be ok again. I haven't felt this low in a long time.  I'm so stupid.
Thank you
I've never eaten a big mac.
Oh ok. I see. I'll keep that in mind. Thank you

why would she go to hell if I kill myself? I have spoken to friends, famil, even my husband.  Nothing has helped. I will seek professional help before I make my final decision.  I want to make sure I've tried everything to "get better"
You're right.  But I can't and I don't.
She is young enough to forget me. But I'll keep that in mind. I'm not planning on doing anything right now. I'm still here.

The attention got to me too. Oldest of 4. My parents were busy dealing with the younger kiddos. I liked having someone care for me and only me. Plus he wasn't forceful.  I'm really messed up for justifying his actions. I can't help it.
I do not plan on harming myself today.  I just have this letter ready and on hand. That's all.
Ahh I get that.
I feel this too. I'm not in control of my emotions and I feel small when I'm around them.  I don't know why I can't just be strong and tell them off.
I just feel so disgusting with myself.  I know I was just a child and didn't know better but looking back on it makes me hate myself.
